findings.title: Explore loads matched banks
findings.expected: At least one bank row after Compare
findings.userImpact: Without matches the rest of Apply cannot be tested.

findings.title: Public / Private filters change the list
findings.expected: Both Public-only and Private-only lists have banks
findings.userImpact: Baseline for selection durability tests.

findings.title: Selected bank stays visible after opposite bank-type filter
findings.expected: Selected "Bank of Maharashtra" remains visible (pinned) when filter is Private-only
findings.actual: Not visible. Visible selected=[]; draftIds=["OFF-1003"]; apply="Apply once to 1 bank"
findings.userImpact: User thinks they still have that bank selected for compare/apply, but it disappears from the list.

findings.title: Selected out-of-filter banks are pinned to the top
findings.expected: Selected banks that fail the current filter still appear at top for compare
findings.userImpact: Cannot compare earlier pick vs new private banks side by side.

findings.title: Apply once navigates with a non-empty packet
findings.expected: Land on apply.html with banks in session packet
findings.userImpact: Broken handoff means Apply cannot start.

findings.title: Apply packet includes earlier public selection after Private filter
findings.expected: Packet includes "Bank of Maharashtra" plus later private pick
findings.actual: Missing public. Banks: Axis Bank; selectedCount=2
findings.userImpact: Customer applies only to the last filtered set; earlier choice is silently dropped before Firebase.

findings.title: Apply button count matches banks that actually apply
findings.expected: Button N === packet.banks.length === meaningful selected set
findings.userImpact: User trusts “Apply to N banks” but fewer banks go to Apply/Firebase.

findings.title: Apply review lists same banks as packet
findings.expected: UI bank list matches packet
